backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing a token ledger and DAO proposal system with voting and treasury-controlled transfers.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata file listing features, related source files, components, and test IDs for the Wooden Spoon DAO project.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing high-level summaries for various frontend components and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining wood-themed OKLCH color variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template loading the React app entrypoint into the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app layout with header, hero banner, and tabbed sections for wallet, DAO, and treasury views.
Component handling Internet Identity login/logout and displaying the connected principal.
frontend/src/features/dao/CreateProposal: Form for creating DAO proposals with validation, identity checks, and mutation to backend canister.
frontend/src/features/dao/daoStatus.ts: Computes a proposal's status based on deadline, execution state, and vote counts, returning flags for voting and execution.
frontend/src/features/dao/ProposalDetail: Displays full details for a selected DAO proposal and provides voting and execution actions with status logic and user feedback.
frontend/src/features/dao/ProposalList.t: Fetches and lists all proposals with status badges, handling loading and errors, and allows selecting a proposal for detailed view.
frontend/src/features/token/TokenBalance: Shows the connected user's token balance with loading and error handling, using token metadata for formatting.
frontend/src/features/token/TransferForm: Provides a form to transfer tokens, including validation, submission handling, and user feedback for success or errors.
frontend/src/features/treasury/TreasuryP: Displays the DAO treasury balance with loading and error states and explains how funds can be allocated via proposals.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing identity loading, login, logout, and status tracking using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching token, balance, treasury, and proposal data and for mutating actions like transfers, proposal creation, and voting via the actor and identity.
frontend/src/index.css: Provides Tailwind-based global styles and OKLCH theme variables for light and dark wooden-spoon-inspired UI themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color tokens, typography, container settings, animations, and extended theme values for the project’s visual style.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s state, features, theme requirements, and pending requests for the Wooden Spoon memecoin and DAO on ICP.
